device.tuner: MaxLinear MxL603 family, by its wake-up: at start the application sets registers 0x0B and 0x12 of a chip at I2C 0x60 to 1 (the MxL603's tuner-enable and start-tune registers), exactly what the Strong SRT 8115's and Cabletech URZ0195's firmwares do before their first tune writes the MxL603 table; this firmware never tunes without channels, so the table itself was not seen

panel.chip: two buttons straight on GPIO inputs, no LED driver

simulator.note: The simulator's first target; its application draws its first screen after a long start (run_dump_capture_screen.py: its channel banner, then the "Нет Сигнала!" (no signal) box).  Its two front-panel buttons sit straight on GPIO 31 and 9 -- the SDK's key task sends them on as its virtual keys 12 / 13, up / down -- and are modelled released (gpio_keys.py, 2026-10-11): read as pressed, the simulator's default for an input nothing drives, they hopped it between its two channels (490 and 578 MHz) every 20-50 s, which earlier notes took for its channel change never completing.  The remote works in its library's extended-NEC coding (ir_remote's "ext00", the T650i's, address bytes DF DF): OK opens the channel list, MENU the main menu ("Редактировать Канал"), EPG the programme guide, EXIT closes each -- its decoder keeps the frame's first address byte as the key table code's high byte, so a standard NEC frame of its MENU (0xFBDD) was looked up as 0x04DD (traced 2026-10-11), and the buttons' channel hopping had hidden every attempt before.  With the demultiplexer model and a transport stream (2026-10-11, sim.attach_mux) it filters the TDT, the PMT PID of its channel after the PAT (0x6A5 = "TVP Opole" programme 0x11 at 578 MHz, 0x321 = "Polsat Sport News" 0x1A at 490 MHz, from its channel database), then the CAT, SDT, NIT, EIT and the video / audio PIDs, and consumes every packet the model writes.  It sets the chip's real-time clock to the TDT's time (rtc_m36.py, 0xB8018A00; unmodelled it read 0, which the firmware made 28/11 01:00), so its banner shows the stream's date and time and the model's EIT ("10/10 13:00", "Now: 13:00-14:00 TVP Opole now" -- "Нет Информации", no information, when the banner comes before the present event's section -- and "Next: 14:00-15:00 TVP Opole next"; run_dump_signal_capture_screen.py) and times out, the channel staying, a clear black picture; its programme guide then has the two events on its time line.  After the tune it polls the demodulator's state register 0x3B (400 reads in 8 s, wanting 1), 0x147 and, after its init command through 0x12E, the event register 0x02 for a done bit -- all answered by the model with a signal.

desc: p.kaczmarek2's Comsat TE 1050 HD, read with a CH341 programmer for the elektroda article of December 2025 on the box's inside, the firmware read-out and the flash partition format.
The application's system-information page names it "M3801", "MC6379-VER1.0", "TE 1050 HD", "DVB-T HD V1.1.5", "Jan 29 2013".  Application: Libcore 8.1c.0@SDK4.0bd.8.7_20121127.

Tuner: the application initialises the chip's two hardware I2C masters (0xB8018200, 0xB8018700; i2c_scb.py) at start and, on the first, wakes a tuner at I2C address 0x60 (registers 0x0B and 0x12 set to 0x01) -- and nothing more until a channel is tuned, which it never does with its empty channel list; the demodulator is the chip's own (the firmware's "NIM_S3811_0").  The driver names no tuner in its strings (none of the M3801 firmwares does); the register table it writes at the first tune would identify the chip.
